name: minimal
description: Sans-only. No serif anywhere. Inter for both display and body, tighter display tracking, neutral-gray scale instead of slate, sentence-case eyebrows instead of uppercase tracking. The page reads quieter and more contemporary than editorial. Best when the buyer is design-conscious or the product is itself minimalist.
